note: Base sphere abilities the canonical catalog read from the wrong heading or left out (docket 2026-09-28; owner 2026-09-28: "Dreamscape base typed as passive; no 'Fragrance' base exists -- fix both so their area talents work"). Each is the ability's printed text from the Sphere Compendium (blank lines dropped, as the catalog does), with the file's path, line and hash; tools/build_typed_mechanics_authority.py sources() uses it in place of (or in addition to) the catalog's row. granted_with: owning any of these records brings the ability (the character sheets list the Sphere's automatic abilities by record, and this one was missing from the catalog).

GRAVITY_BASE_WEIGHTED_STRIKE.name: Weighted Strike
GRAVITY_BASE_WEIGHTED_STRIKE.text:
### Base Technique - Weighted Strike
Tag: Weight Art.
Trigger: You hit a creature with a melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike while Body Lightening or Body Heavying is active.
Cost: 1 CP or Stamina.
Use Limit: Once per turn.
Choose one rider.
Heavying Blow: Add 1d6 Force damage. The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is pushed 5 feet, pulled 5 feet, or knocked Prone, chosen by you. On a successful save, it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Lightening Blow: Add 1d6 Force damage. After the attack resolves, you may move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target of the attack.
Scaling:
CL 5: damage becomes 2d6.
CL 11: damage becomes 3d6.
CL 17: damage becomes 4d6.
GRAVITY_BASE_WEIGHTED_STRIKE.why: The Gravity sphere's Weighted Strike base technique (Core Chassis: Weight Shift, Weighted Strike, External Weight Shift) has no row in the catalog, so the talents that change it (Heavy Weapon Body, Falling Hammer, Light-Body Flurry, Moon-Weight Incarnation, Gravitic Armor, Anchor-Breaking Palm) had nothing to change (rider lane C2, 2026-09-30).

DREAMS_BASE_DREAMSCAPE.name: Dreamscape
DREAMS_BASE_DREAMSCAPE.text:
#### Dreamscape
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Area: 15-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: None
Create one symbolic Dreamscape centered within range.
The Dreamscape is perceptible as drifting symbolism, altered emotional tone, half-heard music, impossible shadows, falling petals, remembered voices, or similar dreamlike impressions.
A Dreamscape does not automatically:
create false terrain;
block line of sight;
make creatures Hidden;
impose a condition;
reveal private memories;
grant literal information. Choose one Dreamscape talent you know and pay its CP cost.
##### Lingering Dreamscape
Augment - 2 CP: The Dreamscape persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after creating the Dreamscape on your turn without spending an Action.
DREAMS_BASE_DREAMSCAPE.why: The catalog's row carries the Dreams sphere's definition of a Dreamscape (the core rules heading of the same name), not the base ability printed under BASE SPHERE ABILITIES.

FLOWERS_BASE_FRAGRANCE.name: Fragrance
FLOWERS_BASE_FRAGRANCE.text:
#### Fragrance
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Area: 15-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: None
Create a drifting spiritual fragrance centered within range.
Choose one Fragrance talent you know and apply it.
##### Lingering Fragrance
Augment - 2 CP: The Fragrance persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after creating the Fragrance on your turn without spending an Action.
FLOWERS_BASE_FRAGRANCE.why: The Flower sphere's Fragrance base ability (Base Sphere Abilities) has no row in the catalog; only its Lingering Fragrance augment does.
